missionAttributions.purpose: Satellite-based detection and mapping of fire and smoke using multiple satellite platforms
missionAttributions.selectionReason: Credential-free historical fire and smoke observations for WP-02 Fire gate
missionAttributions.keyLimitation: Coordinate/placemark counts are not counts of distinct fires, threatened homes, or unsafe users. Cloud, smoke, canopy, and terrain can occlude detections.

freshness.note: Historical fixture from 2025-01-08. This is a test fixture; age does not reflect a live retrieval.

confidence.rationale: Fixture data from a single historical date. Coordinate counts indicate satellite detections were present in the LA area box on 2025-01-08 but do not establish fire perimeter, threat to specific properties, or smoke concentration.

limitations.description: This is a deterministic test fixture. It does not represent current or live conditions.
Coordinate or placemark counts are parsing counts, not counts of distinct fires, threatened homes, or unsafe users.
NOAA HMS is not approved for tactical firefighting, evacuation decisions, or property-level fire certainty.
Cloud, smoke, forest canopy, and terrain can occlude detections. Processing and analyst-review delay applies.
HMS smoke polygons provide broad regional density observations, not calibrated AQI, indoor-air conditions, or evacuation guidance.
